sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: Nickel downstreaming is a multi-year structural driver, with Indonesia's ban on raw ore exports forcing global investment into local smelters and HPAL plants, benefiting companies like ALKA.
Coal demand from China and India remains resilient despite ESG pressures, as Indonesia's low-cost, high-calorific coal producers maintain pricing power and export volume growth.
Government's push for energy transition via geothermal and solar creates a long-term opportunity for domestic EPC contractors and renewable asset owners, though near-term earnings rely on coal.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's mining & energy sector underperformed US peers today, but ALKA's +24.73% surge signals strong local nickel play momentum. Capitalize on this by overweighting downstream nickel processors and coal exporters, as structural demand from EV battery supply chains and China's energy needs remain durable drivers.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's new renewable energy law, mandating 23% renewables by 2025, will drive structural demand for solar and geothermal developers like BRPT and PKPK, despite current sector headwinds.
PLN's accelerated grid modernization and transmission upgrades create durable tailwinds for climate-tech infrastructure, benefiting integrated players like TPIA and CSAP.
US interest rate normalization lowers the cost of capital for Indonesian renewables projects, improving IRR profiles and catalyzing M&A activity in the sector.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables sector is underperforming, but TPIA's +6.22% surge signals selective momentum in green industrial plays. Watch for policy catalysts like the new renewable energy law and PLN's grid expansion plans, which could unlock value in laggards like BRPT and PKPK. Position for a rotation into domestic climate-tech names as US rate cuts ease funding constraints for IDX-listed developers.
